b000126.text: SOCRATES: Leave me then, Crito, to fulfil the will of God, and to follow whither he leads.

profile.policy: Primary inputs include source-inspected author argument, dialogue and verse, including integral author appendices, scholia and within-work introductions. Exclude standalone prefatory front matter and dedications (including author-written front prefaces), later editorial introductions, translator/editor notes and summaries, indexes, contents, pagination and publisher matter. Excluded text remains in original bytes/canonical maps and exhaustive ledgers. Three legacy profiles keep their frozen historical policy and exact inputs; no silent migration. A dialogue speaker is not automatically the author or endorsed.
